plan.estimand: Rate difference in cluster-randomized trial: comparing intervention vs control incidence rates (per child-week)
plan.hypothesis: Two-sided test of equality of event rates between treatment and control arms
assumptions: Cluster rates follow log-normal distribution approximated by coefficient of variation
Between-cluster CV = 0.25 applies to both treatment and control
Poisson process for event occurrence within clusters
Additive one-cluster correction applied per Field Trials Chapter 5 Section 6.1
Equal allocation to treatment and control arms (1:1 ratio)
scientific_notes: Method references: Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1 (cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation with one-cluster additive correction)
Effect size: rate difference = 0.010 - 0.005 = 0.005 per child-week (control minus treatment)
Approximate average rate ≈ (0.005 + 0.010)/2 = 0.0075 per child-week for nuisance parameter in variance calculation
Rounding convention: upward to integer clusters per arm
Specification is complete; calculation can proceed.
